title: Proposition 9.3: testing properties after pullback along closed immersions
statement_scope: Suppose given a pushout diagram of spectral Deligne-Mumford stacks X01→X0, X01→X1, X0→X, X1→X, where i and j are closed immersions. Let f:Y→X be a map of spectral Deligne-Mumford stacks. Set Y0=X0×X Y, Y1=X1×X Y, and let f0:Y0→X0 and f1:Y1→X0 be the projection maps, as printed. Then: (1) f is locally of finite presentation to order n if and only if both f0 and f1 are, for any n≥0; (2) f is locally almost of finite presentation if and only if both f0 and f1 are; (3) f is locally of finite presentation if and only if f0 and f1 are; (4) f is étale if and only if both f0 and f1 are étale; (5) f is an equivalence if and only if both f0 and f1 are equivalences; (6) f is an open immersion if and only if both f0 and f1 are open immersions; (7) f is flat if and only if both f0 and f1 are flat; (8) f is affine if and only if both f0 and f1 are affine; (9) f is a closed immersion if and only if both f0 and f1 are closed immersions; (10) f is strongly separated if and only if f0 and f1 are strongly separated; (11) f is n-quasi-compact if and only if f0 and f1 are n-quasi-compact, for 0≤n≤∞. All eleven clauses are retained whole.
